title: FTP ingress custody and durable completion log
scope: Accept exact completed uploads, claim them and publish one selected collection.
proposed_work_bound: O(B + completed events + path/native-provenance bytes) plus generic publication cost. Process new events from a cursor; no complete intake/log rescan per completion or file.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded active claims, durable receipts and upload windows; disk may retain uncustodied input by policy but no unbounded per-step memory.
semantic_requirement: Same-path reuse, interrupted/resumed upload, completion-log tips and receipt retention exact; delete source only at permitted custody boundary.
proposed_witness: Same path distinct bytes, many completed records, interrupted first file and late receipt; compare events processed and log bytes read over the entire ingress sequence.

title: Gogurt routing, mount providers and listener lifecycle
scope: Read exact marker/configuration, choose a route and react to native volume/listener events.
proposed_work_bound: O(config bytes + examined declared routes + enumerated volumes/events); fixed deployment => independent of files stored inside the mounted volume unless the selected action explicitly traverses them.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Config/volume-sized state and bounded event work; listener state proportional to retained actionable events, not whole payload.
semantic_requirement: Provider/marker identity, revalidation, native lifecycle and trusted executable boundaries remain. External invoked command cost is not Gogurt's bound.
proposed_witness: Grow route/volume counts independently of files; replay/restart/mount replacement, missing executable and marker change; real OS provider checks.

title: Filesystem, AWS and B2 storage adapters
proposed_work_bound: Adapter-owned work O(bytes transferred + declared objects/parts + response metadata). Contacts O(required objects/parts + retries); no bucket-wide listing per exact object operation. Provider internal algorithm/latency explicitly outside adapter guarantee.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded streams/concurrency; explicit multipart/checkpoint state; provider capacity never silently truncates an exact collection.
semantic_requirement: Create-only/read verification, incarnation identity, remote receipt/race semantics, no public provider-specific ontology changes.
proposed_witness: Many tiny objects, one large multipart object, conditional-create races, partial/missing response and resumed reads; count contacts and byte buffering using protocol conformance plus final image.

title: Minisign and OpenTimestamps witnesses
scope: Verify/sign/publish exact witness inputs and progress pending timestamp proofs.
proposed_work_bound: O(input/proof bytes + signatures or proof nodes + requested/pending items); bounded indexed due-work polling. Calendar/network waits excluded, contacts counted; no rescan of all historic witnesses per pending proof.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded active proof processing and retained exact evidence; retention does not discard required proof to save time.
semantic_requirement: Exact root/digest and independent witness authority; no claim a pending timestamp is finalized evidence.
proposed_witness: Grow finalized history at fixed pending set, malformed proof, lost response, retry and changed root; verify signatures/proofs and count historic lookups.
